freezewhenenteringworld.title.freeze_tog: Per-session switch (default OFF). Enables freeze-on-world-enter only for this game session; it resets when you restart the game. For a persistent/server-side switch use the TOML config 'freezeOnWorldEnter'.
Enabled by the TOML config 'freezeOnWorldEnter' in config/freezewhenenteringworld-common.toml. Edit that file (or the mod config screen) to change it.
